  • Elasticity is “When rolling a 19 or 20 on a ranged attack, your critical multiplier is increased by +1” (Bow of Sinew page). reviewed_replacements.after:
other properties can still matter. Keen is not listed among Sapphire Sting’s enchantments.
  • Elasticity adds +1 critical multiplier on natural 19 or 20 ranged rolls (Bow of Sinew page). The additional critical damage requires an applicable confirmed critical that is not negated by fortification; it is not guaranteed extra damage on one tenth of all attacks. A conditional x8 result would become x9 on those qualifying rolls. Bow of Sinew, Twisted Willow, Chaosbow, Aerania, Aeon, Legendary Demon’s Arc, Legendary Demogorgon’s Sinew and The Faceless Lord’s Reach carry it. This does not add Elasticity to the selected Calamitous recipe.

ow, it dies, and it dies fast, because almost nothing in the build is spent on taking damage.

Three facts set the tone, all from the wiki. First, hit points: Ranger rolls a d10 per level and Rogue a d8 (class pages), and the stats put everything into Intelligence and the Dexterity the feats need, so Constitution is whatever is left. Second, healing: the build cannot heal itself in a fight. Wisdom 8 closes the Ranger spell list (a Ranger “needs a Wisdom score of at least (10 + spell level) to prepare and cast spells”), and on Reaper the potions you drink are cut to a fraction anyway (40% of their value at one skull, 4% at ten: Reaper difficulty page). Third, armor: light armor only, which is what keeps Evasion working (“wearing medium or heavy armor” negates it: Evasion page) and what caps Magical Resistance Rating at 100 (MRR page). So the defences you do have are avoidance, position, and the party’s healer. Learn those three and the character is sturdy; skip them and no gear fixes it.

son, disease, stuns from melee specials, and the Doom Reaper’s chain are Fortitude effects.
  • Will is the weak one and nothing in the build fixes it. Ranger Will is +3 at level 9, Rogue +0 at 1, and Wisdom 8 subtracts one. Hold Person, Command, fear, dance and the other mind-affecting effects all test Will. A held archer is a helpless archer: you “cannot attack, cast spells or SLAs, drink potions, activate items or class abilities”, you take extra damage (+25% on Elite and Reaper), and Evasion stops working (Helpless and Evasion pages). This is the single biggest hole in the character and the gear section below addresses it.
reviewed_replacements.after:
son, disease, stuns from melee specials, and the Doom Reaper’s chain are Fortitude effects.
  • Will remains a concern. Starting Wisdom 8 has a −1 modifier before other sources, not a permanently equipped −1 modifier. The selected Wisdom gear can improve the Wisdom contribution; calculate the final modifier after same-type overlaps, then combine applicable class progressions, gear and buffs. Ranger’s listed +3 at level 9 and Rogue’s +0 at level 1 are only part of a multiclass character’s save, not its final total. The current gear subtotals and final Will remain unverified. Hold Person, Command, fear, dance and the other mind-affecting effects all test Will. A held archer is helpless: it cannot act normally, takes extra damage and loses Evasion (Helpless; Evasion). Improved Wisdom is not immunity to those effects.
